messages:
Sam W: quick heads-up — customer (FinApps) expects a committed reserved pool for POC but wants mixed GPU types + aggressive burst. Need deal-desk signoff on special terms and pricing.
Lia M: can you drop the SOW link? do they want preprod/dev excluded from commit?
Sam W: SOW: https://redwood.example/finapps-poc (private). They explicitly want dev excluded — only prod traffic counts. baseline = 4 GPUs (mix 3xA100,2xL4) but they only want to reserve 4 for billing. burst policy: allow up to 300% of baseline for short periods.
Tara C: ok — for carveouts we need explicit language in the MSA. Also need proposed commit term and monthly committed GPU-hours to calculate discount tiers.
Nate R: engineering note: mixed pool will be provisioned as a homogeneous reserved pool behind our routing. Autoscale will pull from pool capacity; burst is best-effort and not SLA-backed. We can pre-warm 2 GPUs to reduce cold-starts.
Sam W: customer insists on latency-sensitive inference hitting A100s first. Can we guarantee routing preference in dedicated pool?
Nate R: yes, we can set routing priority A100 > L4, but if A100s saturated requests will spill to L4. That behavior is fine to document.
PricingBot: quick calc snippet: blended_hourly = (3*A100_rate + 2*L4_rate) / 5. Example rates: A100=$2.70/hr, L4=$0.40/hr => blended ≈ $1.46/hr. Baseline monthly (4 GPUs) ≈ 1.46*4*24*30 = ~$4210. Burst surcharge proposal: blended_on_demand * 1.25 for short bursts.
Tara C: thanks. I'll open a deal-desk ticket with: commit term=12mo, baseline 4 GPUs, dev/preprod carveout clause, warm-pool 2 GPUs as add-on (+15% baseline premium), burst surcharge as PricingBot suggested. Need pricing approval and legal review for carveout.
Sam W: adding customer's procurement contact + security questionnaire to the ticket. They also asked for SAML SSO + IP allowlist.
Mike L: legal here — please include exact carveout language and example billing calc in ticket. We'll need to check tax/transfer language for carveouts.
Lia M: one more ask from customer: ability to cap daily burst spend (safety guard). Can we offer a soft cap with alerts?
Nate R: we can implement soft caps and alerts, enforce hard caps only if they block traffic — that'll impact availability. Recommend soft cap + webhook alerts to their billing system.
Tara C: noted. I'll attach proposed contract amendments and mark ticket as Tier2 (special terms). @Mike L can you review by Thursday? They want signature next week.
Sam W: :thumbsup: I'll update the ticket with SOW, security pack, and sample billing calc. Need decision on warm-pool charge and burst multiplier.
PricingBot: recorded proposal in ticket #DD-3789: Warm-pool = +15% baseline premium, Burst multiplier = 1.25x blended on-demand, Dev carveout = excluded from committed-hours.
Mike L: acknowledged — reviewing tomorrow.
Sam W: thanks team — pushing for EOD Fri signoff to meet their procurement window.
